title: Length of the configuration program
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet, with $k$ work tapes, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T$ be a natural number. Set $S=k(2T+1)+|\ell|+3$; the configuration program formed with stride $S$ and time horizon $T$ has length $(T+1)S$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
